subject.title: fix(release): carry the Z.AI API Platform waiver

question: Should the `extended-stable/2026.6.33` release candidate proceed with Z.AI API Platform validation temporarily omitted while the dedicated Z.AI Coding Plan shard remains required?
rationale: The patch is mechanically aligned with two already-merged main-branch fixes, but accepting a temporarily reduced provider-validation matrix for a release candidate is a release-risk decision rather than a code-correctness determination.

options.title: Approve the temporary waiver
options.body: Merge this backport, complete the candidate-owned release validation, and remove the waiver once the replacement API Platform credential produces a real completion.

options.title: Hold the release candidate
options.body: Keep the branch unmerged until the replacement Z.AI API Platform credential is available and the normal probes can run again.

recommendation.title: Approve the temporary waiver
recommendation.body: Merge this backport, complete the candidate-owned release validation, and remove the waiver once the replacement API Platform credential produces a real completion.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the original merged waiver and the release-branch carry, so they are the strongest available routing candidate for the release-validation context.
